name: Like a Butler
source:
There is a super-rich school. It is really hard to pass the entrance exam. Yes, it is a common knowledge the chosen few are allowed to enter the school. But one day, the school announces that they are accepting in a tuition-exempt student. 

The main character is Kazuki. He hears the news as well, but he is not interested in it. Several months later, the result comes out. The student who passed the entrance exam is Kanade, Kazuki's old friend.  "Oh, what should I do...?" She never expected she would pass, so she is totally panicked. 

When she receives a document from the school, she gets surprised again, "Students are required to have butlers." Kanade says to Kazuki, "Please be my butler!" Like this, he reluctantly becomes her butler... On their first day at school, they enter a completely different world from their old one. Kazuki and Kanade's new school life now begins...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
有一所超級富裕的學校，入學考試極難通過。沒錯，眾所周知，只有極少數的天之驕子才能進入那裡。然而某天，學校宣布將招收一名免學費的學生。

主角名叫和樹。他也聽說了這件事，卻沒有放在心上。幾個月後，結果公佈，通過入學考試的人竟是和樹的舊友奏。「啊，怎麼辦……」她從未想過自己真的能夠考上，因此徹底慌了神。

收到學校寄來的文件後，她再次大吃一驚：「學生必須配有管家。」奏對和樹說：「請你當我的管家！」於是，他不情不願地成了她的管家……入學第一天，兩人走進了一個與舊日生活截然不同的世界。和樹與奏嶄新的校園生活就此開始……

[摘自ErogeShop]
